mcp_tools.name: document_operations_service
mcp_tools.title: Document operations service
mcp_tools.description: Submits a document-operation record (source and extraction, declared documents and findings, editing, preservation, conversion, verification, delivery) and returns a deterministic DOCUMENT_OPERATIONS_SOUND / DOCUMENT_OPERATIONS_NOT_SOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across four sections, including computed output-verification, finding-location and exact-quote coverage checks, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared record; it processes no documents.

inputSchema.description: The document-operation manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and document/finding row schemas).

expect.notes: All 32 checks pass; documents_count=1, findings_count=1, coverages 1.0000, computed_status within_stated_limits_on_declared_evidence. [Tester correction R2: designer carried computed quantities only in prose notes with no structured computed_spot_checks; added structured block.]
